name: Transit fare
description: A ticket on the municipal rail. Needs a record on file. Free once the Conductor's timetable is fixed; cheaper with Maren's help.
successText: The turnstile accepts your band and clicks. A ticket prints.

refusals.null_state: The turnstile reads your band, finds nothing, and displays: PENDING REVIEW. Please wait for an officer.

name: Forged Stacks day pass
description: A pass for the Stacks that will fool a basic scan, and not a thorough one.
successText: Sam slides a card across the counter. It looks real. It is not.

name: Sell scrap wire
successText: Two bundles of wire for twelve credits. Sam weighs it twice.

refusals.requirements: Sam wants at least two bundles of scrap wire.

name: Bribe the records clerk
description: A clerk opens a record for you, in someone else's name.
successText: The clerk never looks up. Your band now carries a record. It is not yours.

name: Quiet Hours forgery
description: During reconciliation the records are in flux, and a pass slips in cheaply. Only works between 02:00 and 05:00.
successText: The record flickers while it is written. By morning it will be gone, but tonight it holds.

refusals.requirements: Not now. The records are steady outside Quiet Hours, and nobody forges anything on a steady record.

name: Signal Lens, fitted
description: Doc Perrin fits a Signal Lens to your wrist band.
successText: Perrin clicks something into your band and tells Statistic not to look. Signal Lens added; wear it from the band menu.

refusals.funds: Thirty credits. The pigeon does not do charity either.

name: Noise-maker
successText: Wren hands over a noise-maker and writes it in a ledger nobody has ever audited.

refusals.funds: 10 credits. Wren is kind, not stupid.
refusals.once: You have those already. They do not wear out.

name: Wire cutters
description: Wren's stores sell a wire cutters.
successText: Wren hands over a wire cutters and writes it in a ledger nobody has ever audited.

refusals.funds: 25 credits. Wren is kind, not stupid.
refusals.once: You have those already. They do not wear out.

name: Stun charge
description: Wren's stores sell a stun charge.
successText: Wren hands over a stun charge and writes it in a ledger nobody has ever audited.

refusals.funds: 40 credits. Wren is kind, not stupid.
refusals.once: You have those already. They do not wear out.

name: The old insider credential
description: A credential that worked once and still does: it puts a record on file, a high one, and MERIDIAN with it.
successText: The checker's lamp turns green. Somewhere a log records that the old auditor has come back.

name: Build Pallas's drive
description: Assemble a repaired drive from a coupler and a memory shard on Doc Perrin's bench.
successText: The coupler seats with a click. The shard goes in. The drive hums.

name: Press a cargo tag
description: Press a cargo tag from a Form 12-C and a permit stamp on Doc Perrin's bench.
successText: Doc Perrin stamps the form and the form becomes a tag. It does not look like much. That is the point.

name: A memory shard
description: Doc Perrin has one in a drawer, and no questions to ask about it.
successText: Perrin slides it across without looking at it.

name: Train 7 to the Gate
description: The service train boards at 13:50 and leaves at 13:52.
successText: The doors hiss. Train 7 pulls out of the Underworks with the service staff and one passenger nobody has counted.

refusals.requirements: Train 7 has not been boarding. It runs at 13:52, and the platform opens at 13:50.

name: Level 3 permit (the Gate Annex)
description: Ines does the paper: a Level 3 pass for the Gate Annex.
successText: Ines stamps, signs, and stamps the signature. It is a perfectly ordinary Level 3 permit.

name: Out through the service gate
description: Staff leave by the service gate in the window when passes, not faces, are checked.
successText: The attendant's lamp reads your pass and not your face. The service gate opens. Nobody stops you.

refusals.requirements: The service gate wants a pass in its hand, and only between 13:50 and 14:10.

name: Out through the authorised exit
description: The controller has been told that you are cleared.
successText: The controller reads its own records, finds an entry that says you may pass, and believes it.

refusals.requirements: The exit's lamp is red. The controller has not been told to open it.

name: Out through the open Gate
description: With the auxiliary power gone, a Gate that is unsure of someone stays open.
successText: The Gate stands open and unsure, the way it was never built to. You walk through it. Behind you, the lamps come back one by one.

refusals.requirements: The Gate is whole. Its auxiliary power is still on.
